closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, dark meat stays flavorful and forgiving to cook, and usually a reasonably affordable whole-food protein, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low vitamin D, and low omega 3. It is good for muscles and strength sports, practical meals, and blood and oxygen support because the protein section supports repair and maintenance, the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, and vitamin B12 supports the blood-and-oxygen side.
